items.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.

purpose.zh: debpalash/VoiceStudio：VoiceStudio是开源、完全本地的ElevenLabs替代品--语音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转录和有声读物创作，支持646种语言。
purpose.en: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.

strengths.zh: 使用⟦Python构建⟧；焦点： ai、有声读物⟧、⟦cuda、配音、elevenlabs-alternative、huggingface ；注意： Electron Rewrite Ongoing ：请勿创建与桌面应用程序相关的问题和pr ；以前的OmniVoice-Studio ；在您自己的硬件上克隆语音、配音视频、听写和制作长格式音频。
strengths.en: Built with Python; Focus: ai, audiobook, cuda, dubbing, elevenlabs-alternative, huggingface; NOTE: Electron Rewrite Ongoing: Please dont't create desktop app related issues and pr; Previously OmniVoice-Studio; Clone voices, dub video, dictate, and produce long-form audio on your own hardware.
